_comment: Config for the keepalive-ping cron service ONLY. It lives INSIDE ops/keepalive because Railway applies a repo-ROOT railway.json to EVERY service built from this repo - on 2026-09-17 a root copy of this file made the BACKEND service try to build this Dockerfile and its deploy failed. The keepalive service must have Root Directory = ops/keepalive so it reads this file and nothing else does.
